<notes>
kept -> base harness -> all 9 rollouts (3 base + 6 candidates) produced identical correct answer 2,366,974 with zero divergence, zero failures, zero mechanical errors

The task is a deterministic arithmetic problem solved entirely through straightforward LLM step-by-step reasoning. All three base rollouts converged identically on the correct answer, as did all six candidates (which show "no change" from base in their diffs). The library precedent (holdout-numeric-002, 003, 005, 010) documents a clear pattern: code extraction + code-generation instruction are applied when LLM reasoning DIVERGES on deterministic computation (base1 ≠ base2 ≠ base3). This task exhibits zero divergence. All decisions (inv1 through dom3) correctly identified this absence and noted that applying the library pattern would speculate beyond the evidence, adding context overhead to a problem that is not manifesting.

The mission states: "Do not fix what the runs already got right" and "Every edit must trace to a moment in a trajectory... If you cannot name the moment, the edit is speculation and costs context for nothing." No trajectory moment shows failure, error, or divergence to justify adding components. The harness is delivering correctly and consistently.
</notes>
